claims.quote: Known in the trade as the 'panda dwarf cichlid', Apistogramma nijsseni is from tributaries of the Río Ucayali in Loreto Region, northern Peru.
Known only from tributaries of the Río Ucayali in Loreto Region, northern Peru including the Río Carahuayte and Río Yavarí.
